title: Positive Test: LTE Single UE Attach and Detach Procedure Validation
description: Validate successful LTE initial attach and UE-initiated detach procedure with a single UE under excellent radio conditions for 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
All other cells are powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration and activate serving cell.
Place UE (real or emulated) at cell center under excellent LTE radio conditions.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure.
Wait for successful attach indication (attach accept and confirmation).
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure.
Wait for successful detach indication (detach accept and signaling connection release).
Stop logging and save logs for KPI measurement.
Repeat steps 4 to 8 for a total of 10 iterations.
expectedResults: Attach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations.
Attach latency measured and recorded for each iteration.
UE is attached to correct LTE cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN) as per test configuration.
Signaling flows confirm successful attach and detach procedures.
postconditions: UE detached and test logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Check UE logs or application for LTE attach confirmation.
Analyze signaling message logs for attach request, attach complete, detach request, and detach accept.
Measure attach latency from attach request to attach complete.
Validate RSRP and RSRQ values to ensure excellent radio conditions.

title: Positive Test: 5G NSA Single UE Attach and Detach with Secondary Node Addition and Release
description: Validate successful 5G NSA attach including EN-DC secondary node addition and UE-initiated detach with secondary node release for a single UE under excellent radio conditions for 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with one active UE under excellent 5G NSA radio conditions (5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
All other cells are powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to the test configuration and activate serving LTE and NR cells.
Place UE (real or emulated) at cell center under excellent 5G NSA radio conditions.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE initial attach and 5G NSA secondary node addition procedure.
Wait for successful attach indication and secondary node addition confirmation.
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and NR cells (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN) per configuration.
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach and secondary node release.
Wait for successful detach and secondary node release confirmation.
Stop logging and save logs for KPI measurement.
Repeat steps 4 to 9 for a total of 10 iterations.
expectedResults: Attach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations.
Secondary Node Addition success rate = 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate including secondary node release = 100% over 10 iterations.
Signaling flows confirm successful attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release.
UE attached to correct LTE and NR cells as per test configuration.
postconditions: UE detached and test logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Check UE logs or application for 5G NSA attach and secondary node addition confirmation.
Analyze signaling message logs for attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, SgNB reconfiguration complete, detach request, detach accept, and SgNB release messages.
Validate RSRP and SS-RSRP values to ensure excellent radio conditions.

title: Negative Test: Attach Failure Due to Poor Radio Conditions
description: Verify that the UE fails to attach when radio conditions degrade below minimum coupling loss or poor RSRP/SS-RSRP values.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE.
Radio conditions degraded below minimum coupling loss or poor RSRP/SS-RSRP.
testSteps: Configure test setup with degraded radio conditions (simulate using variable attenuator or UE emulator).
Place UE under poor radio conditions.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure.
Wait and observe attach failure or timeout.
Stop logging and save logs for analysis.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to poor radio conditions.
No attach complete message received.
Logs reflect attach request retransmissions or failures.
UE does not register with the network.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for attach request retries and absence of attach complete.
Check UE logs for attach failure messages.
Validate radio metrics showing poor RSRP/SS-RSRP.

title: Negative Test: Detach Failure Due to Missing Detach Request
description: Verify network behavior when UE does not send detach request after power off or during detach procedure.
preconditions: UE attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Power ON UE and perform successful attach.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power OFF UE without sending detach request (simulate abrupt power loss).
Observe network handling of missing detach request.
Stop logging and save logs.
expectedResults: Network triggers detach timer or context release after UE power off.
Signaling connection release occurs after timeout or network-initiated detach.
No detach request received from UE.
Network frees UE resources eventually.
postconditions: UE context released on network side.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for absence of detach request and network-initiated context release.
Check network logs for timer expiry or release procedure.
Verify UE context removal in network.

title: Edge Case Test: Attach Latency Measurements at Boundary Conditions
description: Measure attach latency minimum, average, and maximum values over 10 iterations with excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell, single UE under excellent radio conditions.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Repeat attach and detach procedure 10 times as per standard test procedure.
Record latency from attach request to attach complete for each iteration.
Sort latency values in ascending order.
Calculate minimum, average, and maximum latency.
Document latency KPIs as per Table 5-3.
expectedResults: Attach latency values fall within expected performance targets.
No outliers exceeding maximum acceptable latency.
Consistent latency across iterations indicating stable attach procedure.
postconditions: Attach latency KPIs recorded for performance assessment.
verificationMethods: Timing analysis of signaling logs between attach request and attach complete.
Comparison of latency values against expected KPI targets.

title: Performance Test: Stress Test with 10 Consecutive Attach and Detach Iterations
description: Validate network stability and KPI consistency under stress by performing 10 consecutive attach-detach cycles with a single UE.
preconditions: Single cell test environment with UE under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Perform attach-detach procedure 10 times consecutively without delay.
Capture logs for each iteration.
Measure attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency for each iteration.
Analyze KPI trends for degradation or failures.
expectedResults: 100% success rate for attach and detach across all iterations.
Stable attach latency with no significant increase over iterations.
No network resource leaks or failures observed.
Logs confirm consistent signaling behavior.
postconditions: Test logs saved and KPI report generated.
verificationMethods: KPI analysis over all iterations.
Signaling logs review for errors or timeouts.
Resource monitoring on network elements.

title: Security Test: Validate Authentication and Authorization During Attach
description: Verify that UE attach procedure includes successful authentication and authorization as per 3GPP standards.
preconditions: Test environment with authentication server and configured subscriber profile.
testSteps: Power ON UE and initiate attach procedure.
Capture signaling messages including authentication request and response.
Verify authentication challenge and response exchange.
Confirm attach complete only upon successful authentication.
Attempt attach with invalid credentials to verify rejection.
expectedResults: Authentication is correctly performed during attach.
Attach completes only after successful authentication.
Attach rejected with invalid or missing credentials.
No unauthorized UE attach allowed.
postconditions: UE attached or rejected as per authentication outcome.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for authentication messages (e.g., Authentication Request, Authentication Response).
Check network logs for authorization decisions.
Verify UE behavior on authentication failure.

title: Integration Test: LTE and 5G NSA Attach and Detach Procedures in E2E O-RAN Setup
description: Validate seamless interaction between LTE and 5G NSA components during attach and detach with single UE in O-RAN architecture.
preconditions: Configured LTE eNB and 5G NR gNB connected via O-RAN interfaces.
Single UE under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Power ON UE and initiate combined LTE initial attach and 5G NSA secondary node addition.
Verify signaling interaction between LTE eNB and 5G NR gNB including SgNB addition.
Power OFF UE to initiate detach and secondary node release.
Verify signaling interactions for SN release between MN and SN as per Clause 10.4.1.
Capture and analyze end-to-end signaling flows.
expectedResults: Successful attach and secondary node addition with proper O-RAN interface signaling.
Successful UE-initiated detach and secondary node release with coordination between MN and SN nodes.
No signaling errors or message loss.
Consistent KPI measurements across LTE and 5G NSA components.
postconditions: UE detached and resources released on both LTE and NR nodes.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for proper message exchange on O-RAN interfaces.
Verify UE log reports for correct attach to LTE and 5G cells.
Validate SN Release procedure messages (SgNB Release Request, Acknowledge, UE Context Release).

title: Usability Test: Verify Simplicity and Clarity of Test Configuration and Logging Procedures
description: Assess the ease of configuring test parameters, starting/stopping logs, and recording KPIs in the test setup.
preconditions: Test environment with configuration interface and logging tools.
testSteps: Configure test parameters as per test configuration guidelines.
Start and stop logging capturing call flow and signaling messages.
Record KPIs after test completion.
Evaluate clarity and accessibility of configuration and logging steps.
Gather feedback from test engineers on usability.
expectedResults: Test configuration is straightforward and clearly documented.
Logging tools are easy to operate and provide required data.
KPI recording is systematic and user-friendly.
No ambiguity in test instructions.
postconditions: Test configuration and logs are saved accurately.
verificationMethods: User feedback surveys.
Observation of test procedure execution.
Review of test documentation clarity.

title: Compatibility Test: Verify Attach and Detach Procedures Across Different UE Emulator Versions
description: Validate that attach and detach procedures function correctly with various versions of UE emulators under the same test configuration.
preconditions: Multiple versions of UE emulator available.
Single cell test environment configured.
testSteps: For each UE emulator version:
Configure test setup identically.
Perform 10 iterations of attach and detach procedure.
Capture KPIs and signaling logs.
Compare results across emulator versions.
expectedResults: All UE emulator versions achieve 100% attach and detach success rates.
No significant differences in attach latency or signaling behavior.
Test setup works consistently regardless of UE emulator version.
postconditions: Compatibility report generated comparing all versions.
verificationMethods: KPI comparison across emulator versions.
Signaling log analysis for anomalies or deviations.
Verification of radio parameters consistency.

title: Registration Test: 5G NSA UE Registration including Registration Request, Accept, and Complete
description: Validate the 5G NSA UE registration procedure from initial Registration Request through Registration Accept to Registration Complete.
preconditions: Single cell LTE and 5G NSA environment.
UE powered off and ready for registration.
testSteps: Power ON UE and initiate Registration Request to network.
Capture signaling messages including Registration Request, Registration Accept, and Registration Complete.
Verify network responses and UE state transitions.
Confirm registration completion and UE context establishment.
expectedResults: Registration Request successfully sent and received by network.
Registration Accept received by UE.
Registration Complete sent by UE.
UE successfully registered and able to initiate services.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for registration messages.
Verify UE state via logs or application interface.
Confirm network records for registered UE.

title: PDU Session Test: 5G NSA PDU Session Establishment including Authentication, Accept, and User Plane Setup
description: Validate PDU Session establishment procedure including PDU Session Establishment Request, Session Authentication if applicable, PDU Session Accept, User Plane setup, and N3 Tunnel creation.
preconditions: UE attached and registered on 5G NSA network.
Configured SMF, UPF, and N11, N4 interfaces active.
testSteps: UE initiates PDU Session Establishment Request.
Capture signaling for session authentication procedure if applicable.
Verify PDU Session Accept message received by UE.
Confirm user plane setup including N3 tunnel creation.
Monitor QoS Flow establishment and session release signaling.
Validate SMF and UPF interactions via N11 and N4 messages.
expectedResults: PDU Session Establishment completes with successful authentication and acceptance.
User plane setup and N3 tunnel creation completed successfully.
QoS Flows established as per configuration.
Session release procedures function correctly when triggered.
postconditions: Active PDU session established for UE.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for PDU Session messages.
Validate user plane tunnel establishment via network logs.
Check SMF and UPF logs for N11 and N4 message exchanges.
Monitor QoS Flow parameters.

title: Handover Test: 5G NSA Xn Handover Procedure including Measurement Report to Handover Complete
description: Validate the Xn handover procedure in 5G NSA scenario including Measurement Report, Handover Required, Handover Request, Handover Request Ack, RRC Reconfiguration, Path Switch, and Handover Complete.
preconditions: UE attached and registered on 5G NSA network.
Two gNBs available for handover.
Radio conditions configured to trigger handover.
testSteps: Configure UE to report measurement events.
Trigger Measurement Report from UE to source gNB.
Source gNB sends Handover Required to target gNB.
Target gNB replies with Handover Request Ack.
Source gNB sends RRC Reconfiguration to UE with handover command.
UE performs handover and establishes connection with target gNB.
Target gNB initiates Path Switch procedure with core network.
UE sends Handover Complete message to target gNB.
Capture and analyze all signaling messages involved.
expectedResults: Measurement Report correctly triggers handover procedure.
Handover Request and Ack exchanged successfully between gNBs.
UE performs RRC Reconfiguration and connects to target gNB.
Path Switch procedure completes successfully.
Handover Complete message received and UE service continuity maintained.
postconditions: UE connected to target gNB and service ongoing.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for handover messages.
Monitor UE logs to confirm successful reconfiguration and connection.
Validate core network Path Switch signaling and state updates.

title: Negative Test: Secondary Node Release Rejection by SN during Detach
description: Verify network behavior when Secondary Node rejects SN Release request due to SN change procedure trigger.
preconditions: UE attached in 5G NSA mode with active secondary node.
SN configured to reject SN Release requests.
testSteps: Initiate UE-initiated detach procedure triggering MN initiated SN Release.
MN sends SgNB Release Request to SN.
SN rejects SN Release due to SN change procedure trigger.
Observe signaling messages for rejection and further network handling.
Capture and analyze logs.
expectedResults: SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message with rejection indication.
MN processes rejection and handles accordingly per specification.
UE detach proceeds or is deferred based on network behavior.
No resource leak or inconsistent states in MN or SN.
postconditions: UE context and SN state consistent after rejection handling.
verificationMethods: Analyze SN response messages for rejection.
Check network logs for handling of SN Release rejection.
Validate UE and network states post rejection.

title: Edge Case Test: Timing Coordination in Secondary Node Release Procedure
description: Validate behavior and impact of timing coordination between MN and SN during data forwarding and SN Status Transfer in SN Release procedure.
preconditions: UE attached in 5G NSA mode with active secondary node.
Data forwarding enabled between SN and MN.
testSteps: Initiate MN initiated SN Release procedure.
Observe sequence of SgNB Release Request, Acknowledge, and RRCConnectionReconfiguration messages.
Monitor timing of SN Status Transfer message and start of data forwarding.
Repeat test with SN initiated SN Release procedure.
Capture and analyze whether SN Status Transfer occurs before or after data forwarding start.
Assess impact on service provision.
expectedResults: SN Status Transfer message may be sent before or after data forwarding starts as per specification.
No service gap or degradation due to timing variations.
Network handles timing coordination gracefully.
No UE reconfiguration failures.
postconditions: SN resources released and UE context updated appropriately.
verificationMethods: Timing analysis of SN Release signaling messages.
Service continuity monitoring during SN Release.
UE logs for reconfiguration success or failures.
